en: Sepia-toned panoramic view over a dense European town with tightly packed, gabled-roof buildings and a few taller industrial chimneys in the background. The vantage point appears elevated, likely from a church tower, overlooking the central part of the town and surrounding countryside. At the top of the image, printed in German, is the caption identifying the location and viewpoint.
